title: Grateful Dead Live at Pyramid Arena on 1995-04-02
lineage: DAT master > Tascam DA20 Mark II DAT > Roland SRC-2 sample rate/format converter (from SPDIF to Optical) > Mac Mini > Audacity 3.0 at 48K > Wave 16/48
source: flac16/48kHz; Set 2 Chuck Vasseur FOB Recording: Neumann KM54 modified tube mics, hand held on t-bar > Custom PS > TEAC Deck > DAT; John Ammons

ai_review.summary: Nice arena sound captures a stoked performance with a raw but compelling Crazy Fingers
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clear, arena‑type ambience that lets the band’s energy shine through; reviewers note the group is playing “pretty stoked.” Crazy Fingers stands out, especially the plaintive “I tried” moment toward the end, even if Jerry’s tone sounds a bit raw.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review, but it praises both the show and the sound, suggesting a good musical performance with decent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer mentions "nice arena sound" indicating clear ambience; no major flaws noted, though Jerry's tone is described as raw.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall positive vibe; band described as playing pretty stoked with no specific pacing issues mentioned.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Fairly raw on Crazy Fingers but delivers a plaintive "I tried" moment near the end.
